title: 第一卷 第17章 师姐喜欢发福利第一卷 第18章 夜遇女杀手
slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙

两人同行着下山，期间闲聊了起来。
叶云八卦之魂燃起，好奇的问道。
“墨师姐，听说你已经订婚，对方还是真传弟子？”
提及此事，墨如烟脸色阴郁几分，轻轻点了下头。
叶云并未察觉，还在感叹道。
“真好啊，能与真传弟子结为道侣，像我是没这机会了。”
这一番话，似乎刺激到墨如烟的内心，她冷声道。
“我压根不想与他订婚，也不喜欢他。”
叶云愣了一下，诧异地看向她。
“不喜欢？那你还为何……”
墨如烟沉默了片刻，转脸看向天空淡淡道。
“人生在世，有些时候，总会身不由己。”
“……”
一番简单的交谈，叶云大体也看出来，对方应该是被逼婚了。
“那你……”
在他想更深一步了解时，墨如烟却是摇了摇头，意思很明显，别再继续问下去。
见此，叶云也只好作罢，心中无奈的叹了口气。
没办法，面对人家真传弟子的事，自己区区一个外门弟子，哪怕想帮对方也无能为力。
一时之间，两人都安静了下来，谁也没再开口说什么。

倒是有路过的玉女峰弟子，在见到他们一同下山，脸上露出了惊讶之色。
“那不是墨如烟吗？她怎会跟一个老男人待在一起？”
“看那墨如烟的头发，好像还没干透，怎么感觉像是刚洗过澡一样？”
“哇，真的欸，他们两个不会是……那种关系吧？”
“看那老家伙的腰牌，还是个外门弟子，这可有意思了。”
“……”
他们所过之处，不少人都低声议论，说什么的都有。
实际上，如果只是个墨如烟，还不至于她们这么在意，玉女峰弟子玩花的也并不少。
可关键，这墨如烟可是那位真传弟子的未婚妻……
……
在玉女峰的山脚，墨如烟望着布满青苔的阶梯道。
“从这里一路下去即可下山，你应该不会迷路了吧？”
的确，这要是再迷路，那叶云可以找块豆腐撞死了。
“多谢师姐，那我就先走了。”
叶云咧嘴一笑，接着就准备转身离去。
可就在这时，墨如烟似是想到什么。
“对了，还有个事情。”

The two walked down the mountain together, chatting during the process.
Ye Yun's spirit of gossip ignited and he asked curiously.
"Senior Sister Mo, I heard that you are engaged. Is this person still a true disciple?"
When this matter was mentioned, Mo Ruyan's face turned gloomy and he nodded slightly.
Ye Yun didn't notice it and was still sighing.
"It's great to be able to become a Taoist couple with a true disciple. I never have this opportunity."
These words seemed to stimulate Mo Ruyan's heart, she said coldly.
"I don't want to be engaged to him at all, and I don't like him."
Ye Yun was stunned for a moment and looked at her in surprise.
"Don't like it? Then why do you..."
Mo Ruyan was silent for a moment, then turned to look at the sky and said calmly.
"In life, there are times when you can't help yourself."
"..."
After a simple conversation, Ye Yun roughly figured out that the other party was probably forced into marriage.
"Then you..."
When he wanted to know more, Mo Ruyan shook his head, meaning clearly, don't ask any more.
Seeing this, Ye Yun had no choice but to give up and sighed helplessly.
There is no way, facing someone else's true disciple matter, I am just an outside disciple, even if I want to help him, I can't do anything.
For a moment, both of them became quiet, and no one said anything more.
However, some Jade Girl Peak disciples who were passing by showed surprise when they saw them going down the mountain together.
"Isn't that Mo Ruyan? How could she stay with an old man?"
"Look at Mo Ruyan's hair, it doesn't seem to be dry yet. Why does it feel like he just took a shower?"
"Wow, really, the two of them can't have... that kind of relationship, right?"
"Look at that old guy's badge. He's still an outer disciple. This is interesting."
"..."
Wherever they passed, many people whispered about everything.
In fact, if it was just Mo Ruyan, they wouldn't care so much, and there were not many Jade Girl Peak disciples who played tricks.
But the key point is that Mo Ruyan is the fiancée of the true disciple...
…
At the foot of Jade Girl Peak, Mo Ruyan looked at the moss-covered stairs.
"You can go down the mountain all the way from here. You shouldn't be lost, right?"
Indeed, if Ye Yun gets lost again, he can find a piece of tofu and kill him.
"Thank you, senior sister. I'll leave first."
Ye Yun grinned, and then prepared to turn around and leave.
But at this moment, Mo Ruyan seemed to think of something.
"By the way, there is one more thing."
